body:
"McGarrett, Five-O" wrote in message ...
>At a time like this, does he have information that could help
>the FBI catch terrorists?

I doubt that Ted Kaczynski would help authorities even if he knew
anything.  Although the Unabomber claims to be a vast terrorist
network known as "FC," there is no evidence that this "group"
ever consisted of anyone but Ted himself.

"In order to get our message before the public with some chance
of making a lasting impression, we've had to kill people."
-- The Unabomber Manifesto

headers.Subject: Re: Is Unabomber helping the authorities?
